# Room card (`room-card`)

One room at a glance: temperature and humidity, lights on, open windows, and quick toggles.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createRoomCard` (types in `dist/web/home/rooms/roomCard.d.ts`): `.mh-room-card` (on a `.mh-control-card` frame): the room name with temperature and humidity on the state line, `__facts` (lights on, windows open) and `__toggles`, quick `button.mh-room-card__toggle`s with `aria-pressed`. The card is lit (`warm`) while any light is on. Toggles are controlled: pressing one calls `onToggle` and the pressed state follows the next `update`.

```ts
export function createRoomCard(options: RoomCardOptions): RoomCardHandle;

export interface RoomCardOptions {
  /** The room's name; also the card's accessible name. */
  name: string;
  /** Leading icon (default a sofa). */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** The room temperature, already in `unit`. */
  temperature?: number | null;
  /** Default "°C". */
  unit?: string;
  /** Relative humidity in percent. */
  humidity?: number | null;
  /** Lights on now; the card takes the lit look while any are. */
  lightsOn?: number | null;
  lightsTotal?: number | null;
  /** Windows (or doors) open now; shown as a warning. */
  open?: number | null;
  toggles?: readonly RoomToggle[];
  labels?: Partial<RoomCardLabels>;
  unavailable?: boolean;
  /** Makes the header a button that opens the room. */
  onOpen?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
  /** A quick toggle was pressed: its id and the state asked for. The toggle shows the new state once `update` brings it. */
  onToggle?: (id: string, on: boolean) => void;
}

export interface RoomCardHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  update(changes: Partial<RoomCardOptions>): void;
}

/** Every visible word, for translation. Counts are passed to functions so plurals can be right. */
export interface RoomCardLabels {
  /** "2 of 5 lights on"; `total` is null when unknown. */
  lights(on: number, total: number | null): string;
  /** "1 window open". */
  open(count: number): string;
  /** "48% humidity". */
  humidity(percent: number): string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { mdiFan } from '@mdi/js';
import { createRoomCard, type RoomToggle } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

let toggles: RoomToggle[] = [
  { id: 'lights', label: 'Lights', icon: 'lightbulb', on: true },
  { id: 'fan', label: 'Fan', icon: mdiFan, on: false, tone: 'cool' },
];

const card = createRoomCard({
  name: 'Living room',
  temperature: 21.5,
  humidity: 46,
  lightsOn: 3,
  lightsTotal: 4,
  toggles,
  onOpen: () => location.assign('#/rooms/living-room'),
  onToggle: (id, on) => {
    toggles = toggles.map((t) => (t.id === id ? { ...t, on } : t));
    card.update({ toggles });
    if (id === 'lights') card.update({ lightsOn: on ? 4 : 0 });
  },
});

document.body.append(card.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { mdiFan } from '@mdi/js';
import { RoomCard } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { RoomToggle } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

export function RoomCardExample() {
  const [toggles, setToggles] = useState<RoomToggle[]>([
    { id: 'lights', label: 'Lights', icon: 'lightbulb', on: true },
    { id: 'fan', label: 'Fan', icon: mdiFan, on: false, tone: 'cool' },
  ]);
  const lightsOn = toggles.find((t) => t.id === 'lights')?.on ? 4 : 0;
  return (
    <RoomCard
      name="Living room"
      temperature={21.5}
      humidity={46}
      lightsOn={lightsOn}
      lightsTotal={4}
      toggles={toggles}
      onOpen={() => location.assign('#/rooms/living-room')}
      onToggle={(id, on) => setToggles((list) => list.map((t) => (t.id === id ? { ...t, on } : t)))}
    />
  );
}
```
